qing_name_evidence.decision: Use お青 for the queen in Win 12078-12083
qing_name_evidence.search: Exact scans of decoded Win 阿青/青儿 and Saturn 青 plus local context; not a manual reading of every script line.
qing_name_evidence.relevant_confirmation: JP15436 immediately preceding the target and JP14291 explicitly address the queen as お青. JP10896/10899 concern a different alchemist and are recorded only to avoid conflating identities.

source_references.purpose: 003C -> upper; operands are face, font color, RNG flag
003D -> lower; operands are face, font color, RNG flag
Trigger-script return resets default dialogue through PAL_EndDialog
Default for scripts without explicit dialogue command: upper, no face, title12/8, body44/26
16-WORD event record; trigger is WORD4, zero-based
Scene ownership by event-object index ranges
RLE optional DWORD2 followed by width/height WORDs

boundaries: All four semantic corrections are confirmed; suggestions are new corrected Japanese, not unchanged Saturn source.
Do not add or remove CLEAR markers or copy Win pagination into the Japanese blocks for this minimal correction.
Win3448 contains malformed trailing bytes; the shared complete Chinese sentence is independently confirmed by strict CP950 DOS4030.
Gambler and child are direct event entries without an explicit 003B-003E; upper/no-face render commands are defaults, not raw instructions.

Modified lower-dialogue lines fit before portrait rectangle boundaries at nominal 16px advances. Unmodified lines and actual ink/shadow overlap still require the main agent source-render verification.
No gameplay or original Saturn screen acceptance is claimed.
